title: Use the long service leave calculator
summary: Use this online calculator to determine your long service leave entitlement.
intro:
Most full-time, part-time or casual employees in NSW are entitled to long service leave. If you've been with the same employer for 10 years, you're entitled to 2 months (8.67 weeks) paid leave. This leave is paid at your ordinary gross weekly wage.

faqs.a: Most full-time, part-time or casual employees in NSW are entitled to long service leave.

faqs.q: How much leave do I get after 10 years of service?
faqs.a: If you've been with the same employer for 10 years, you're entitled to 2 months (8.67 weeks) paid leave.

faqs.q: Am I eligible for a pro-rata payment if I have less than 10 years of service?
faqs.a: If you have completed 5 years (but less than 10 years) of service, you may be entitled to a long service pro-rata payment.
